verification_levels.verified: Exact model or exact document identity verified from a primary or directly matching source.

verification_levels.missing: Document known or strongly expected to exist but not yet located.

research_log.summary: Fresh multi-language search repeated across exact-model, service manual, electrical schematic, hydraulic schematic, Chinese manual/drawing terms, manual repositories, GitHub code search and historical product listings. No authenticated full HMD400M6 OEM service/drawing pack was located.

Verified a direct 80-page M8M/M10M Standard HMI Controller & Software Manual PDF. It covers operations, panel keys/screens, I/O diagnostics/reassignment, machine diagnostics, machine-set data, DA adjustment and alarms, while explicitly requiring the machine manufacturer's manual for machine safety/general operation/maintenance. Exact HMD400M6 OEM service/drawing pack still not found.

models.generation_note: FANUC official α-S100iB electric-machine model specification, not an installed machine or serial-verified option. Published base clamp is 1000 kN; increased 1250 kN is separate. Mould-height ranges differ for single vs double platen and increased options. Screw data are one published 200 mm/s operating table, NOT certified fitted injection-unit IDs or universal high-pressure filling limits.

manufacture_year.evidence_note: An individual machine year and serial has not been established from OEM model literature.

controller.family: FANUC ROBOSHOT CNC; PANEL iH Pro named on official model product page
controller.host_note: The product page markets PANEL iH Pro, but the fitted controller/HMI revision, parameters, wiring and firmware for any specific serial are not authenticated.

published_screw_data.mode: OEM 200 mm/s base operating table (not high-duty, higher-speed or high-pressure filling mode)
published_screw_data.scope: Published operating-table values only; 1 and 2 are distinct pressure modes. They must not be treated as simultaneously available, the machine's as-built rating, or a validated usable process limit.

research_log.summary: Verified FANUC ROBOSHOT α-S100iB from the manufacturer's own product specification. Nominal 1000 kN versus increased 1250 kN, single/double platen height ranges and 200 mm/s injection-and-hold pressure modes are explicitly not collapsed into one fit rating. Actual serial, unit, available speeds, firmware, wiring and service manual remain unverified. No production machine suitability/recipe authority.
